title: Computational Modeling of Exciton-bath Hamiltonians for LH2 and LH3 Complexes of Purple Photosynthetic Bacteria at Room Temperature
summary: Light harvesting 2 (LH2) complex is a primary component of the photosynthetic unit of purple bacteria that is responsible for harvesting and relaying excitons. The electronic absorption line shape of LH2 contains two major bands at 800 nm and 850 nm wavelength regions. Under low light condition, some species of purple bacteria replace LH2 with LH3, a variant form with almost the same structure as the former but with distinctively different spectral features.
